source_text.ISS-0937:
id: ISS-0937
title: "Backend CI red at UTC month boundary: TenantTemplateTest parity (extra events_y2026m09) and PartitionMaintenance/RetentionOperations/EventRetention tests ({:error,:partition_not_eligible}) fail on 2026-10-01"
discovered_by: ELIXIR-DEV
discovered_in_run: WF03-ISS0930-20261001 (Step Final, PR #2076; filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-10-01T00:21:56Z"
severity: MAJOR
description: >
  PR #2076 (scripts/fixtures-only, no lib/ or migration change) had its backend job fail twice. Run 1: one TenantTemplateTest
  parity failure extra=["events_y2026m09"]. Re-run after the 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-01 UTC rollover: 12 failures in
  PartitionMaintenanceTest, RetentionOperationsTest, EventRetentionTest ({:error, :partition_not_eligible}). Hypothesis, not
  reproduced on main: the tests depend on the real current UTC month / partition eligibility and break at the month boundary.
  PR #2076 was merged with --admin per decision 0018. Confirm via main's CI on ed40c2fa, then make the tests clock-independent.
affected_files:
  - test/letflow/events/ (partition maintenance / retention tests)
  - test/letflow/tenants/ (tenant template parity test)
queue_ref: Q-920  # queue issue_ref ISS-0920 collides with an existing local file; local filename ISS-0937
github_ref: GH-2077
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 2b CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR gate for ISS-0937. Validate lib/letflow/design/iss0937-month-boundary-test-clock.md against: the diagnosis in step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json and the ISS-0937 record (acceptance: make the tests independent of the real UTC month; backend CI green on any date). INDEPENDENTLY verify the code citations in the worktree (partition_maintenance.ex eligibility rule ~lines 360-363; tenant_template.ex/check_table_set; the three test files' eligible_past_month helpers; test/support/tenant_fixture.ex). Check: every cause has a concrete change; offset rule is correct for all days incl. 1st/2nd/month lengths/Jan wrap and min age N>=1 (do the arithmetic for several dates yourself, e.g. 2026-10-01,2026-10-02,2026-01-01,2026-03-01 with N=1 and N=31); the dynamic-partition filter regex cannot hide a genuine non-partition extra table; fail-first tests truly fail on pre-fix logic regardless of real date; the audit of clock-sensitive sites is complete (run your own grep of test/ for shift_months/current_month/Date.utc_today/DateTime.utc_now/events_y); no implementation code and no lib/ or migration change in the design; owned_modules correct. Modify nothing but this handoff. Set IN_PROGRESS at claim then COMPLETED/FAILED with result.status PASS/FAIL (list concrete defects if FAIL). next_action 'Route to ELIXIR-DEV' on PASS.

result.summary: All five checks pass. (1) Citations verified independently: partition_maintenance.ex:360-364 eligibility rule; tenant_template.ex check_table_set/2 (~1207-1222) filters only the missing side; eligible_past_month at partition_maintenance_test.exs:237, retention_operations_test.exs:143, event_retention_test.exs:71-73; req376 predicate in tenant_fixture.ex:408-421 with dynamic regex; test/support/tenant_template_test.exs already exists (design correctly says add, not new); test/support/*_test.exs are run (default test_paths=test). (2) Offset rule M=shift(month_of(today-N),-1): proof holds (cutoff=first_of_month(d)+N<=d+N=today; M+1 cutoff>today). Checked N=1: 2026-10-01->2026-08, 10-02->09, 2027-01-01->2026-11 (Jan wrap), 2026-03-01->2026-01, 2028-03-01->2028-01; N=31: 2026-10-01->2026-07 (cutoff 09-01), 2026-01-01->2025-05. Legacy rule ineligible only on day 1 (matches test 3). (3) Fail-first valid: pure-arithmetic tests and fixed-name hand-built schemas, no wall clock; parity tests 1 and 3 raise extra=[...] pre-fix; mirror/missing-side test 2 passes pre-fix but is not claimed fail-first; source-scan legacy strings exist at the cited lines. Dynamic regex requires exact month 01-12 and 4-digit year, so non-partition extras (widgets_extra, events_extra, events_y2026m13) still raise; fixed tables stay compared on extra side. (4) Audit complete: my grep of test/ (shift_months/current_month/Date.utc_today/events_y/min_partition_age) finds only the 3 eligibility sites + tenant_template/tenant_fixture(+fixture_test); other sites (ensure_future_partitions +3..+5, EO-003 current-month row, 400-day default test) are date-safe. (5) No impl code, no lib/ or migration change; owned_modules (section 7) correct and a superset of handoff (adds partition_clock_test.exs and tenant_fixture.ex). Non-blocking notes for ELIXIR-DEV: keep zero-arity local wrappers; use one @override_age_days attribute; fix partition_maintenance_test.exs:51 moduledoc formula; wrapper must read Date.utc_today() once per call.
